name: Suction bucket / suction pile
description: Inverted open-bottom tube sealed at top; penetrate by self-weight then by pumping water out to create negative pressure (suction); removable by pumping water in to create overpressure. Used as anchors for floating platforms and as foundations for fixed structures and wind turbines.

specifications.value: push or pump water out of skirt to create negative pressure; removal by overpressure
